Implement 4 honest-refuse / detection fixes across /opt/nxeon/worker/migrate-detect.ts and /opt/nxeon/worker/migrate-real.ts (Nxeon migration engine). After editing run `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit` until CLEAN (exit 0) and `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsx --test test/migrate-consolidate.test.ts` (green). Do NOT run the worker, deploy, or commit. These turn SILENT drops into NAMED steps — the goal is honesty, not automation. If you add a field to `ScanResult`, make it OPTIONAL (`?`) and populate it at every construction site (grep for where ScanResult / the return of `detectSource` and `syntheticScan` are built) or tsc breaks. Report per-fix final line numbers.

## FIX WEB-2 — detect host-level alternative reverse proxies and honest-refuse (today they're silently dropped → site falls to the nginx default page)
Detection is limited to nginx/apache config trees; a source fronted by host-installed Caddy / Traefik / HAProxy / Lighttpd / LiteSpeed is invisible, so the engine serves the stock nginx welcome page with no warning. (Containerized proxies are already handled — do NOT touch that.)
- migrate-detect.ts: probe for a host-level alt proxy — presence of `/etc/caddy`, `/etc/haproxy`, `/etc/traefik`, `/etc/lighttpd`, `/etc/litespeed` OR the binaries (`command -v caddy|haproxy|traefik|lighttpd|litespeed|lshttpd`) OR one of those listening on 80/443. Emit an OPTIONAL `altProxies?: string[]` on ScanResult (names found).
- migrate-real.ts: when `altProxies` is non-empty AND the engine is about to generate its own nginx/apache config, push ONE honest blocking step per proxy naming it: "your site is fronted by <proxy> on the old server; Nxeon can't translate its config, so it generated a clean nginx config instead — your <proxy> routing/TLS rules were NOT carried. Reference copy kept at <path>." Keep the reference-copy behavior. Do not try to translate the config.

## FIX OS-3a — non-systemd source: detect + honest-refuse (services silently dropped)
Service discovery is guarded by `command -v systemctl`; on an OpenRC/SysV/runit/s6 source it yields zero services and section 11 does nothing — non-listening daemons vanish silently.
- migrate-detect.ts: detect when the source has NO systemd (`command -v systemctl` fails) but DOES have init scripts — note which init system + dirs (`/etc/init.d`, `/etc/service`, `/etc/sv`, OpenRC `rc-status`). Emit an OPTIONAL `nonSystemdInit?: {system:string; dirs:string[]}` (or similar) on ScanResult.
- migrate-real.ts: when set, push an honest step naming the init system and the script dirs, saying those services were detected but not migrated automatically (the pm2/listening-port capture still catches web apps), so the operator can reproduce daemon/worker services. Do NOT claim services migrated.

## FIX OS-3b — nftables drop policy: detect + honest-refuse (site silently unreachable)
Only ufw/firewalld/iptables are handled; a source using pure nftables with a restrictive input policy silently blocks 80/443 on the new box.
- migrate-detect.ts: detect an ACTIVE nftables ruleset with a drop/reject input policy (`nft list ruleset` present AND a `policy drop`/`policy reject` on an input chain, when ufw/firewalld aren't the active manager). Emit an OPTIONAL `nftablesDropPolicy?: boolean` (or fold into the existing firewall detection shape).
- migrate-real.ts: when set, push an honest step (mirror how the existing iptables case is NAMED, not applied) telling the operator the source used an nftables drop policy that wasn't reproduced and to open 80/443 (+ their app ports) on the new server, so the site can answer. Reuse the existing firewall-reporting style (search the ufw/firewalld/iptables handling ~2316-2342).

## FIX SEC-1 — SSH authorized_keys: opt-in copy + always name (today silently omitted → deploy keys break)
`/root/.ssh` is excluded from copy, so SSH `authorized_keys` (deploy keys, ops access) silently stop working after cutover.
- Add a flag `const COPY_SSH_KEYS = process.env.MIGRATE_COPY_SSH_KEYS === "1";` near the other flags (RENAME_CLONE_CONTAINERS / OVERWRITE_TARGET_DATA / SRC_READONLY).
- When the source has `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` for root and/or migrated users: if `COPY_SSH_KEYS` is true, copy ONLY the `authorized_keys` file(s) (NOT private keys, NOT the whole `.ssh`) to the corresponding target users' `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` with correct 0600 perms + ownership, and report it. If false, push an honest step naming that authorized_keys were found but NOT copied (deploy keys/ops access won't carry) and that setting MIGRATE_COPY_SSH_KEYS=1 will copy them. NEVER copy private keys. Be careful with the existing `/root/.ssh` exclusion — this is a targeted, keys-only, opt-in copy that must not broaden the exclusion.

## Constraints
- Only THIS agent edits these files now. Match existing style; validate interpolated values; single-quoted `sh -c '…'`.
- Do NOT regress any of the container/compose/data-safety/web/units work already in migrate-real.ts (commit 7229b43) or the timers work in migrate-detect.ts.
- Finish only when tsc is clean AND the consolidate test passes. Report per-fix line numbers, which ScanResult construction sites you touched, and the SEC-1 flag name.
